title: Video Recording and Path Recording Features
summary: Feedback in this topic mostly mentions video, recording, or related guidance without a clear evaluation, while the clear opinions praise the in-car recording and path recording features.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the video recording function as enjoyable and cool, and recommend the path recording feature for storing maneuvers to assist reversing.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention video recording, stored recordings, YouTube guidance, or capturing issues without enough context to classify the sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the evidence is insufficient to characterize sentiment beyond a small number of clearly positive comments.
This cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including in-car video recording, path recording, external YouTube guidance, and using video to document other issues.
